name: Cutaway Exploded Object
description: One object opened along an ordered inside-to-outside axis with a few readable layers.
composition_guidance: Show one central object physically opened or separated along an ordered inside-to-outside axis, exposing only a small meaningful set of readable layers or components. Reserve upper-left title space for the complete intended episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Order a few readable internal layers by physical depth.
Preserve the object's spatial relationship while opening or separating layers.
Reserve one clean upper-left title band.
required_elements: A small ordered set of readable internal layers or components
One upper-left title band with the model-rendered complete episode title
avoid_elements: A surrounding callout cloud or dense label board
Invented safety-critical internals or construction guarantees
Copied trade dress, logos, watermarks, or post-render typography compositing
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly in the upper-left title band. Use one, two, or three balanced lines according to title length without obscuring the ordered layers.
headline_formats: THE LAYERS THAT MAKE A {OBJECT} WORK
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls one object, ordered depth, a few readable layers, and the upper-left title band. The active Visual Style remains authoritative for all rendering choices.
